note.note:
I don’t have the transcript or the DDx JSON. Please provide both so I can generate the SOAP clinical note.

Needed:
- The raw transcript (conversation between clinician and patient) — paste full text between <<< >>> as in the instructions, or upload.
- The DDx JSON output from the diagnostic agent — paste full JSON between <<< >>>.

Optional but helpful:
- Any available vitals, exam findings, or investigation results not in the transcript.
- Clarify whether you want the note for charting or for patient handoff.

I will:
- Treat the transcript as the primary source and use the DDx only when consistent.
- Follow the exact SOAP structure and quality checks you specified.
- Not invent values; I will flag any conflicts or missing expected items.

When you provide the transcript and DDx I will produce the SOAP note.
